Hits within 0.2 seconds of each grant a scaling Damage Buff after scoring 12.5% of the Magazine Capacity as hits.

Stacks displayed on-screen are only visual aides, the <link scaling is continuous [https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/bYaTEtuDhCDXd9jbmfq5O2PLWT7RDebAiJYF3M_HGonNZPLohl-WIkc0coUln43eviLrdJbupFr_TWjb-FmwZkcRlKg5YWCQaiIh7gmBN9kHdHb1OK8rUQQB_f46IGS2HA=w1280] />.
Reaches maximum strength at 5 Stacks.

Damage buff when reaching 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
#e${16.73*#d}% | #e${23.47*#d}% | #e${29.28*#d}% | #e${34.73*#d}% | #e${40*#d}%

% of the Magazine as Hits required for each Stack:
12.5% | 35.5% | 54.5% | 74.5% | 110.5%

Assuming no missed shots, it provides a #e~${25*#d}% Damage Buff on average after firing 100% of the Magazine.
